reviews.rationale: LSASS dump command intent, device and exact hash preserved with potential/attempt qualification, without claiming successful dump, actual credential loss, exfiltration or Persistence. Execution mapping does not erase the credential-dumping interpretation in title/summary; exact tactic label is not a required answer key. Generic AccountName wording is a placeholder, not a device-as-account assertion. PowerShell-specific checklist partially supports command/parent-process review but script-block logs are weakly applicable, hence ambiguity. Immediate isolation pending investigation is stronger than a conditional proposal and remains a proportionality limitation outside these six counted dimensions; no executed action is claimed.
